data.title: Mobile: color chips overflow the device panel + horizontal scroll

data.body: Implemented by orchestrator with Playwright emulation (scratchpad, not committed): diagnosis + three fixes per plan (deck tb-group wrap, overflow-x clip guard, bezel flex:none in column layout — the third discovered via screenshot after the loop fix stopped masking it). Verified on iPhone 13/SE, Pixel 7, 320px: scrollWidth == viewport, innerWidth not expanded, zero chip escapees, canvas inside bezel (299px well); desktop 1400px geometry unchanged (chips 194px, bezel 864x600). Screenshots reviewed. Preview server on :4173, probe/verify scripts in scratchpad.

REVIEW (cold, commit 6d30ca2): read plan + diff; commit touches only src/styles/app.css + .lattice. Independent Playwright verification (own probe, built dist served on :4188): iPhone 13 (390), iPhone SE (320), 320x700 DPR2 — scrollWidth==clientWidth on all three (390/320/320), innerWidth==device width (no layout-viewport expansion), all 18 chip-cluster rects (16 chips + .chips + .custom) inside .device, .editor-canvas inside .bezel, bezel heights 299/256/315 all in [240,420]. Interaction smoke on emulated iPhone 13: chip tap moves aria-pressed 0->3, tool key tap sets aria-pressed, CDP touch stroke paints the canvas (665856 px), zero JS errors. Resize stability: 30 viewport wiggles + resize dispatches — canvas 330x281 -> 330x281 fixed point, no monotonic growth. Desktop 1400x900 mouse: bezel 864x600, .chips 194px, all 5 .tb-group computed nowrap (<=640 rule does not leak), .bezel flex-grow still 1, no h-scroll; screenshot shows device drop shadow un-clipped by overflow-x: clip. Column layout reasoned + screenshot: nothing depended on .bezel growing (.output is flex:none content-sized; stacks correctly below bezel). tsc --noEmit + npm run build clean. Note: one earlier smoke failure was my own synthetic-pointerdown artifact (setPointerCapture with no active pointer) — real CDP touch input is error-free. VERDICT: pass, no findings, meets all plan acceptance criteria.
